gate.services_ready_meaning: Gateway and registry are reachable; target is registered; required shared services are ready. Target residency is separate.

process.termination_evidence: zombie; process exited but parent has not reaped it

backend.label: lab pipeline barcode-dinov3-vitl16-crop: the embedding gx10-dinov3-vitl16, after the code lookup

sam3.label: SAM3 'barcode, bottle, label, bottle neck, can', threshold 0.35, mask 0.5, max side 1536; the largest label that is not the package (build_labels.py), else the largest label; a second label on the bottle, less than 0.8 inside it, with >= 0.25 of its area and >= 0.6 of its width: the box of the labels, no mask; else the mask: mask blur 0.005 of the long side, keep >= 64/255; edge blur 1.0 px
sam3.package: SAM3 'wine bottle, can, packet, box', threshold 0.35, mask 0.5, max side 1536; 'wine bottle' first, except a bottle printed on a packet or a box (cover 0.9, box area < 0.1); mask blur 0.005 of the long side, keep >= 64/255; edge blur 1.0 px

backend.score: the mean of the best cosine of the wine in each view of the photo; the current items of the index alone
